caribbean.headline: Freeport Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds, Calm Seas
caribbean.paragraph: Freeport, Bahamas, is experiencing 88% rain probability, with sustained winds up to 17 kt and waves peaking at 2.0 ft. St. Maarten in the Eastern Caribbean reports sustained winds up to 21 kt, while the dominant swell remains at a 9‑second period from the southeast.

mediterranean.headline: Haifa Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds, 5.4 ft Waves
mediterranean.paragraph: Haifa is experiencing sustained winds up to 18 kt and waves reaching 5.4 ft, with a 62% rain probability. Lisbon, the next most impacted port, is seeing winds of 12 kt and lower wave activity.
